service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , COMPANY_NAME FROM USERVICE WHERE HOUSE_CODE <> '000' AND COMPANY_CODE = '1000' AND HOUSE_CODE = $S{HOUSE_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND ( UPPER( HOUSE_CODE ) LIKE CONCAT('', UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%' )) OR UPPER( COMPANY_CODE ) LIKE CONCAT('', UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%' ) OR UPPER( COMPANY_NAME ) LIKE CONCAT('', UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%' ))
SELECT HOUSE_CODE , FORM_ID FROM #DB_OWNER#SFORM WHERE HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND FORM_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}), '%') AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY FORM_ID ASC
